reason: Specification v002 applies F1 (also given as the FOR CLAUDE note 104845). AC1 now requires "Search" as placeholder text inside the field, no separate visible label, and an explicit accessible name "Search" so screen-reader users still get a label. AC6, the scope, the accessibility NFR and the test constraint were updated to match, and the rest of v001 is unchanged. This change departs from the rule in docs/coding-standards.md that every control has a visible label. The spec records it as an exception for this one input, which the reviewer confirms by approving v002.
